name: Breathe In
source:
Breathe In is a horror visual novel set in a small European city surrounded by mountains and forests.  

You are Fang (name can be changed at the beginning of the story), an 18 year old dog, anxious about the upcoming final exams and college admission.  

At the beginning of your last year of high school, you and your friend stumble upon something horrible that triggers an unexpected chain of events.  

Things will only get worse until the end of the year: you’ll have to deal with the final exams, figure out what college you want to go to, and cope with something that has been terrorizing the small city for ages.

[From [url=https://wolfgang-66.itch.io/breathe-in]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《呼吸》是一部恐怖视觉小说，以一座被群山和森林包围的欧洲小城市为背景。

你是方（故事开头可以化名），一只18岁的狗，为即将到来的期末考试和大学录取而焦虑。

在高中最后一年的开始，你和你的朋友偶然发现了一些可怕的事情，引发了一系列意想不到的事件。

直到今年年底，情况只会变得更糟：你必须应对期末考试，弄清楚你想上哪所大学，并应对多年来困扰这座小城市的事情。

[来自[url=https://wolfgang-66.itch.io/breathe-in]Itch.io[/url]]
